# bob periods

Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time

```text title="bob periods --help"
Manage period notes: weeks, quarters, years, and all time

Bare `bob periods` runs the read-only list. ensure creates missing period notes and never edits an existing one. show reads daily intention fields or period reports. update applies a field-fingerprinted card envelope under the vault lock. migrate adopts the vault (dry run by default; -a applies one commit).

Usage: bob periods [COMMAND]

Commands:
  brief    Print the agent review bundle for a day, week, quarter, or year
  draft    Draft a day's summary or a period's summary plus Review (never overwrites Bryan)
  ensure   Create missing period notes one week ahead
  list     List period notes with review states (default)
  migrate  Adopt the period-note tree (dry run by default)
  show     Show daily intention fields or a period report
  update   Apply a guarded intention card update

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob periods` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob periods brief yesterday     Print the agent bundle for a day with its instructions
  bob periods brief 2026-W45     Print the agent review bundle for a week
  bob periods draft yesterday -i summary.md  Draft the day's summary
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md  Draft the week's summary plus Review section
  bob periods ensure             Create missing notes one week ahead
  bob periods                    List period notes with review states
  bob periods list -k week       List only weekly notes
  bob periods list -p            Report period-note problems
  bob periods ensure -n -f json  Preview the writes as JSON
  bob periods migrate            Preview adopting the period-note tree
  bob periods migrate -a         Apply the adoption in one commit
  bob periods show               Show this week's stats strip data
  bob periods show yesterday     Show a daily note's fields
  bob periods show 2026-Q4 -f json  Print the quarter report as JSON
  bob periods update yesterday -i update.json  Apply an intention card update

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, reports, and JSON.
Run 'bob periods <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob periods brief

Print the agent review bundle for a day, week, quarter, or year

```text title="bob periods brief --help"
Print the deterministic, versioned agent bundle (brief v3) for a day, week, quarter, or year: instructions first, then header, intentions, facts, time, parts (periods only), finished, started and dropped, still open, practice (year only), Bryan's words, the previous day's summary (day only), events, this note and its neighbours (v3), day summaries with coverage (week only), off-clock counts, and caveats. Day briefs carry the day v1 instructions; period briefs carry the same v3 text the folded callouts carry. The command is read-only. all_time has no review. See docs/periods.md for the brief contract and token budgets.

Usage: bob periods brief [OPTIONS] [SUBJECT]

Arguments:
  [SUBJECT]
          Day or period id or note path (today, yesterday, last-day, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, daily path, week, quarter, year, last-week, last-quarter, or last-year); all_time has no review

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: md (Markdown) or json

          [default: md]
          [possible values: md, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob periods brief yesterday
  bob periods brief 2026-W45
  bob periods brief 2026-Q4 -f json
  bob periods brief 2026 -f md

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE           Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  brief
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage (bad id or flags), missing daily note, or all_time (which has no review)

See docs/periods.md for the brief contract and token budgets.
```

## bob periods draft

Draft a day's summary or a period's summary plus Review (never overwrites Bryan)

```text title="bob periods draft --help"
Write a day's frontmatter summary from -i/--input (a file path, or - for stdin): one paragraph of 1–3 sentences, at most 60 words and two links, stored as `summary` with its digest and date. Or split a period draft from -i/--input: the opening `**Summary:**` paragraph (the one-release `**Headline:**` alias still reads; joined onto one line on save, at most 25 words) becomes the frontmatter summary, and the remaining text becomes only the `## Review` body (a summary-only draft may leave an empty Review body). Total caps: day 60, week 250, quarter 400, year 600. An open or future subject, an edited summary or Review, or a reflection beside existing agent content is refused unless -F/--force is passed; a reflection never blocks a first draft. The note must exist (daily notes are never created; a period note must contain `## Review`); all_time has no review. See docs/periods.md for the draft rules and JSON errors.

Usage: bob periods draft [OPTIONS] [SUBJECT]

Arguments:
  [SUBJECT]
          Day or period id or note path (today, yesterday, last-day, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, daily path, week, quarter, year, last-week, last-quarter, or last-year); all_time has no review

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -F, --force
          Draft an open subject or overwrite protected content (Bryan said redo, or asked for so far)

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -i, --input <FILE>
          Draft text file, or - for stdin (required)

  -n, --dry-run
          Plan without writing files

Examples:
  bob periods draft yesterday -i /tmp/summary.md
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i /tmp/review.md
  bob periods draft 2026-Q4 -i - < review.md
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md -n
  bob periods draft 2026-W45 -i review.md -F

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  drafted (or planned with -n)
  1  vault I/O or transaction failure
  2  usage (bad id, flags, or draft text)
  3  refused (subject open, or state edited/reflected)

See docs/periods.md for the draft rules, word caps, and JSON errors.
```

## bob periods ensure

Create missing period notes one week ahead

```text title="bob periods ensure --help"
Create missing period notes one week ahead: the week, quarter, year, and all-time chains for today (or --date) and for that date plus seven days. Missing notes are created from the deterministic scaffold; existing notes that are empty, whitespace-only, or only frontmatter (the stub a clicked dangling link leaves) are filled. A note with body content is never touched. A re-run writes nothing. With -R/--refresh-instructions, stale agent callouts in existing notes are refreshed in one commit instead. See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods ensure [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --date <DATE>
          ISO date to ensure for, as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

  -n, --dry-run
          Plan without writing files

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -q, --quiet
          Print nothing unless files were written

  -R, --refresh-instructions
          Refresh stale agent callouts in existing period notes (one commit)

Examples:
  bob periods ensure
  bob periods ensure -d 2026-12-28
  bob periods ensure -n -f json
  bob periods ensure -q
  bob periods ensure -R

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  ensured
  1  vault I/O failure or lock busy
  2  usage error

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, scaffolds, and JSON.
```

## bob periods list

List period notes with review states (default)

```text title="bob periods list --help"
List the period notes that exist, newest first, grouped year → quarter → weeks. Each row shows its review-state mark and its Summary. -p/--problems reports dangling daily parents and intention links, malformed, over-cap, or legacy intention fields, missing period notes, unscaffolded notes, wrong parents, task rows, and stale instructions. The command is read-only. See docs/periods.md for summaries, review states, problems, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -k, --kind <KIND>
          Show only one period kind

          [possible values: week, quarter, year]

  -p, --problems
          Report period-note problems (read-only)

  -y, --year <YEAR>
          Show only periods in one ISO year, as YYYY

Examples:
  bob periods
  bob periods list
  bob periods list -k week -y 2026
  bob periods list -p
  bob periods list -f json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  list
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage error

See docs/periods.md for summaries, review states, and JSON.
```

## bob periods migrate

Adopt the period-note tree (dry run by default)

```text title="bob periods migrate --help"
Adopt the period-note tree: create all_time.md and the ISO week/quarter/year notes in range, adopt in-range year notes (keeping zorg_* keys and archiving the old body), re-parent out-of-range year notes and canonical daily notes, and add the week link on standard prev/next nav lines. Dry run by default. -a/--apply runs one verified vault-rewrite commit. See docs/periods.md for the range, verify, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods migrate [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --apply
          Write the plan and make one verified commit

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -o, --offline
          Commit locally; skip vault sync before and after

  -s, --since <DATE>
          First day of the adoption range, as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the ISO year start

Examples:
  bob periods migrate
  bob periods migrate -s 2025-12-29
  bob periods migrate -a
  bob periods migrate -a -o
  bob periods migrate -a -f json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE           Stats config used by the apply verify
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  planned or adopted
  1  vault I/O or transaction failure
  2  usage error
  3  refused (not a worktree, dirty paths)

See docs/periods.md for the range, verify, and JSON.
```

## bob periods show

Show daily intention fields or a period report

```text title="bob periods show --help"
Show intentions, summary, reflection, and review state for a daily note, or the stats strip and parts-table data for a week, quarter, year, or all time. With no SUBJECT, show the current ISO week. Daily subjects accept YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, a canonical daily note path, today, yesterday, and last-day. The command is read-only. See docs/periods.md for the JSON contract and aggregation rules.

Usage: bob periods show [OPTIONS] [SUBJECT]

Arguments:
  [SUBJECT]
          Day, period id, canonical note path, today, yesterday, last-day, last-week, last-quarter, or last-year; defaults to the current week

Options:
  -k, --clock <CLOCK>
          Pomodoro clock: worked, off-clock, or total

          [default: worked]
          [possible values: worked, off-clock, total]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob periods show
  bob periods show yesterday -f json
  bob periods show 2026-W45 -f json
  bob periods show 2026-Q4 -k total
  bob periods show all_time -f json

Environment:
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE  Exact Bob config file; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_DIR          Bob vault root; defaults to ~/bob
  BOB_NOW          Local datetime override that pins today for the report
  NO_COLOR         Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  report
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  usage, unknown period, config error, or non-Dataview task format

See docs/periods.md for the calendar, JSON contract, and display rules.
```

## bob periods update

Apply a guarded intention card update

```text title="bob periods update --help"
Apply the guarded JSON envelope written by the intention card to a daily, week, quarter, or year note. The envelope carries a field fingerprint; Bob re-reads under the vault lock and preserves unrelated body edits. Summary edits clear the agent draft stamps. Dry runs may omit expect to read current values and the fingerprint. See docs/periods.md for the envelope, operations, Undo, and JSON.

Usage: bob periods update [OPTIONS] --input <FILE> <SUBJECT>

Arguments:
  <SUBJECT>
          Day, period id, canonical note path, today, yesterday, last-day, or a relative period

Options:
  -n, --dry-run
          Plan without writing files

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -i, --input <FILE>
          Guarded JSON envelope file, or - for stdin

Examples:
  bob periods update yesterday -i update.json -f json
  bob periods update 2026-11-19 -i - -n -f json < preview.json
  bob periods update 2026-W47 -i undo.json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root; defaults to ~/bob
  BOB_NOW                   Local datetime override that pins today
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  previewed or updated
  1  vault I/O, lock busy, or stale fields
  2  usage or invalid envelope/operation

See docs/periods.md for operation shapes and JSON errors.
```
